content.comment_body: Any advice on installing [product_name] [version_no] would be greatly appreciated! It's surprising that in 2024, installer issues persist. The main challenges are: 1) Java VM isn't available as such; you only have Java from the official website, and there seem to be no controls for it in OSX or Safari. This appears to be a dependency issue. 2) After downloading installer files, OSX users are limited by problem 1. Clicking the install button leads to nested archives, and the setup file fails to work. Very disappointed that the [product_name] demo installation isn't quick across platforms. I've tried several times over six months and had no success. Online searches show many face the same issue, but there aren't solutions. Is [company_name] aware of this issue, and are they trying to address it? Thanks, a frustrated future user (maybe!)
You should contact [company_name] directly with a support request.

The problem is your operating system (Mac OS 14) is too new. The current [product_name] ([version_no]) supports: • Windows: Windows 7 (64 bit), Windows 8 (64 bit), Windows 10 (32/64 bit), or Windows 11 • Linux: SUSE Linux 15 (64 bit) • Mac OS: Mac OS 10.14 Mojave, Mac OS 10.15 Catalina, Mac OS 11 Big Sur, Mac OS 12.1 Monterey. Recommended Java Runtime Environment: Amazon Corretto 11.0.13.8.1.

Thanks, but I think [company_name] should really improve their approach! The Mac OS versions you listed are years out of date and aren't even supported by Apple for security or updates anymore. The same applies to the Windows versions you mention—quite outdated!

[product_name] is not a native application for Mac OS, Windows, or Linux, but is Java-based. Software development takes time, and Java versions can't be changed during development. So, development by [company_name] and Java (Corretto) both affect release timing. That's why [product_name] will always lag behind OS updates compared to software designed for just one platform (usually Windows). For example, only [product_name] [version_no] is released for Windows 11, not earlier versions. It's best not to use the very latest OS if you need compatibility. For example, I stick with Windows 10 for consistent performance with required applications. My IT department always installs the latest security patches, and I recommend doing the same—it seems you already do.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face substantial challenges installing [product_name] [version_no] demo on the latest Mac OS versions due to incompatibility with current operating systems and dependencies like Java. Official support covers only outdated OS versions, making installation on new systems difficult. Users are frustrated by slow updates and lack of modern compatibility from [company_name], making it harder for new users to get started.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and modern installation process that works easily on up-to-date, officially supported operating systems without complex dependency requirements.
